en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town in a hilly landscape. A broad river with barges and small boats curves through the middle, crossed by a metal railway or road bridge. On the left a steep hill rises directly from the riverbank, crowned by a prominent church or chapel with a tall spire. Below the hill are dense urban buildings along the quay; to the right of the river are rail yards with multiple trains and sidings, orchards or fields laid out in neat rows, and several freestanding villas or large houses. In the background are rolling hills and patchwork farmland. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image itself.
